source.publisher: Social Justice & Special Assistance Department, Government of Maharashtra
source.official_eligibility_text: Eligible elderly individuals aged 65 and above, whose names are on the Below Poverty Line (BPL) list, receive monthly financial assistance under the Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme.
